Coram: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE PRADEEP KUMAR SRIVASTAVA ------
For the Petitioner : Mr. A.K. Chaturvedy, Advocate For the State : Mr. Devesh Krishna, Addl.P.P ------
Order No.07 Dated- 21.02.2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

Apprehending his arrest in connection with Chandwa P.S. Case No. 82 of 2022 instituted under Sections 406, 409, 420, 467, 120-B and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.
As per FIR, allegation is that petitioner has committed criminal breach of trust and cheated huge amount of money of the informant and other women victims on pretext of providing loan to them.

Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all rather he has been falsely implicated in this case only because he is husband of the co- accused Soni Kumari.
It is further submitted that petitioner has no concern with alleged occurrence and no transactions entered into between the women victims and present petitioner.
Petitioner has no criminal antecedent and he undertakes to co-operate with the investigation of the case.
Hence, the petitioner may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.

Learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner and submits that the present petitioner hatched a conspiracy along with his wife and other bank officials and got sanctioned loan amount in favour of the victims including the informant and misappropriated the said loan amount.
Hence, petitioner may not be extended privilege of anticipatory bail.

Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of allegation against petitioner coupled with materials available on record, I am inclined to extend privilege of anticipatory bail to Amit Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... ... on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/187161664/

sentences.text: Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court within four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrendering, he will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (Twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned ACJM, Latehar in connection with Chandwa P.S. Case No. 82 of 2022 with the condition that he will co- operate with the investigation of the case and appear before the investigating officer as and when noticed by him and furnish his mobile number and photocopy of the Aadhar Card with an undertaking that he will not change his mobile number during the pendency of the case and subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) Pappu/
